purpose: Teach: 鳴る/さっと/一段と/行き来/ハンカチ/飴/尻尾/足首

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 駅のチャイム、ホームで鳴る瞬間、好き。
lines.en: I like that moment when the station chime rings across the platform.
lines.style: Gentle, almost dreamy. Soft attack on the opening. Voice settles into the thought like she's sharing something small and true. Unhurried pace, slight warmth.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。さっと電車に乗り込もう。
lines.style: Quiet agreement. Brief, grounded. Not rushing her thought — just moving with her into the next moment. Easy company tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今日の試験、一段と難しかったね。
lines.en: Today's exam was way harder than usual.
lines.style: Dry observation underneath. Light, slightly deflating exhale on the opening. Pace steady but the tone pulls back — testing whether he'll agree or dismiss it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 駅前の店、行き来が減って、寂しい雰囲気だ。
lines.en: That shop by the station has been losing customers. It feels quieter now.
lines.style: Noticing something he shouldn't have to notice. Soft, almost reluctant. Like he's surfaced from watching something sad. Trailing off slightly on the final word.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お母さんがハンカチに名前縫ってくれたの。
lines.en: My mom actually sewed my name onto my handkerchief.
lines.style: Brightness breaking through. Softer than excitement — more like genuine warmth remembering something careful that was done for her. Slight lift in the middle, grounded at the end.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 飴、いる?ポケットに余ってる。
lines.en: Want some candy? I've got extras in my pocket.
lines.style: Casual, unhurried offer. Matter-of-fact delivery but the openness underneath. The ease of someone checking if she needs something without making it a big thing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 犬の尻尾、振り方で気分わかるよね。
lines.en: You can tell how a dog's feeling by the way its tail moves.
lines.style: Animated, noticing something bright. Voice brightens with the observation. Natural pace, conversational — like she's sharing something that just occurred to her. Genuine interest.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 長く立ったから、足首、痛い。
lines.en: I've been standing for so long — my ankles are killing me.
lines.style: Dry, small complaint without self-pity. Light wince in the voice. Quick pace on the setup, softer land on the payoff. Exhaustion without drama.
